c74object.name: el.function~
c74object.digest: Generate additive waveforms, envelopes, and window functions into a buffer
c74object.description:
el.function~ synthesizes mathematical functions, window shapes, and multi-stage envelope curves directly into a single-channel (mono) buffer~. Supported functions include additive harmonic waveforms (addsyn), window curves (rcos, gaussian), and segment-based envelopes (aenv, adenv, adrenv). Envelope segments are defined as fractions of the total buffer duration (0.0 to 1.0).
Inlets
Inlet 1 (messages): Control inlet. Accepts messages to generate envelopes, additive waveforms, and window functions (addsyn, aenv, adenv, adrenv, rcos, gaussian, normalize).
Outlets
None. Functions are written directly into the referenced buffer~.

inlet.description: Receives messages to synthesize waveforms, envelopes, and windows into the target buffer.

objarg.name: buffer-name
objarg.description: Required. The name of the single-channel (mono) buffer~ to write into.

method.name: addsyn
method.description: Fills the buffer with a sum of harmonically related sines. The first value specifies DC offset; subsequent values specify the amplitudes of harmonic partials 1, 2, 3, etc. If normalize is enabled (default), the resulting waveform is scaled to peak amplitude 1.0.

method.name: adenv
method.description: Generates an envelope with linear attack and decay segments. Arguments: attack_fraction (linear ramp to 1.0), decay_fraction (linear ramp to sustain level), and optional sustain_level (default: 0.333). From the end of the decay, the envelope ramps linearly from the sustain level to 0.0 over the remaining duration of the buffer.

method.name: adrenv
method.description: Generates a 4-stage envelope with linear segments. Arguments: attack_fraction (ramp to 1.0), decay_fraction (ramp to sustain level), release_fraction (ramp from sustain level to 0.0 at the end of the buffer), and optional sustain_level (default: 0.333). The space remaining between the decay and release forms a flat sustain plateau.

method.name: aenv
method.description: Generates a two-stage envelope. The argument specifies the attack duration as a fraction of total buffer length (0.0 to 1.0 exclusive), ramping linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The remainder of the buffer decays linearly from 1.0 back to 0.0.

method.name: gaussian
method.description: Fills the buffer with a Gaussian window bell curve.

method.name: normalize
method.description: When set to 1 (default), waveforms created with addsyn are automatically peak-normalized to 1.0. When set to 0, normalization is bypassed and raw summed amplitudes are written.

method.name: rcos
method.description: Fills the buffer with a full period of a raised cosine (Hann) window curve.
